WATER_RELEASE@0.last: Completed: climb out, hose up — transit to the fire.
WATER_RELEASE@0.now: Drop run on a flank: 0.0 t of 192 t out along 2.5 km, retaining 808 t as descent ballast.
WATER_RELEASE@0.next: Next: escape climb on surplus buoyancy.
WATER_RELEASE@0.plan: Simulated cycle 1: 192 t delivered per drop (808 t held back as descent ballast), 26 min per cycle — 440 t/h to this fire if every cycle ran as modelled. Wind not measured; still-air plan. Current constraint: descent ballast — cryogenic capacity. Mode endurance; 130 kWh per delivered tonne; record basis, feasible in this model.

BUOYANCY_ESCAPE@0.77.last: Completed: drop run along the fire.
BUOYANCY_ESCAPE@0.77.now: In the simulation, the ship climbs along the force-checked profile; buoyancy and retained water are modelled, with 808 t of water kept aboard.
BUOYANCY_ESCAPE@0.77.next: Next: return — make ballast, descend to hose range.
BUOYANCY_ESCAPE@0.77.plan: Simulated cycle 1: 192 t delivered per drop (808 t held back as descent ballast), 26 min per cycle — 440 t/h to this fire if every cycle ran as modelled. Wind not measured; still-air plan. Current constraint: descent ballast — cryogenic capacity. Mode endurance; 130 kWh per delivered tonne; record basis, feasible in this model.

RETURN_TRANSIT@0.46.last: Completed: escape climb on surplus buoyancy.
RETURN_TRANSIT@0.46.now: Returning with retained water at 132 km/h; cryogenic plant making ballast — 4.2 t of 9.3 t. The simulated ship stays at the planned altitude using 20 MW of rotor power, with 808 t of water aboard.
RETURN_TRANSIT@0.46.next: Next: final approach — hose paying out.
RETURN_TRANSIT@0.46.plan: Simulated cycle 1: 192 t delivered per drop (808 t held back as descent ballast), 26 min per cycle — 440 t/h to this fire if every cycle ran as modelled. RETURN_TRANSIT@0.98.last: Completed: escape climb on surplus buoyancy.
RETURN_TRANSIT@0.98.now: Returning with retained water at 54 km/h; cryogenic plant making ballast — 9.1 t of 9.3 t. Descending to hose range on 53 MW of rotor downforce and the ballast aboard.
RETURN_TRANSIT@0.98.next: Next: final approach — hose paying out.
RETURN_TRANSIT@0.98.plan: Simulated cycle 1: 192 t delivered per drop (808 t held back as descent ballast), 26 min per cycle — 440 t/h to this fire if every cycle ran as modelled. WATER_FILL@0.67.last: Completed: final approach — hose paying out.
WATER_FILL@0.67.now: On station, just filling: 3.0 m³/s — 937 t of 1,000 t aboard (topping up the 192 t delivered last run); incoming mass is replacing rotor downforce.
WATER_FILL@0.67.next: Next: climb out, hose up — transit to the fire.
WATER_FILL@0.67.plan: Simulated cycle 2: 192 t delivered per drop (808 t held back as descent ballast), 26 min per cycle — 440 t/h to this fire if every cycle ran as modelled.
